definitions.explanation: The act of revealing hidden information, secrets, or wrongdoing to the public, often in a sensational way.

examples.japanese: {秘密|ひみつ}を{暴露|ばくろ}する。
{内部|ないぶ}{告発|こくはつ}{者|しゃ}が{不正|ふせい}を{暴露|ばくろ}した。
{暴露|ばくろ}{本|ぼん}がベストセラーになった。
examples.english: The tell-all book became a bestseller.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{秘密|ひみつ}を{暴露|ばくろ}する - to expose a secret
・{真実|しんじつ}を{暴露|ばくろ}する - to reveal the truth
・{暴露|ばくろ}{本|ぼん} - tell-all book, exposé
・{暴露|ばくろ}{記事|きじ} - exposé article

NUANCE:
Often implies sensational or scandalous revelation. Used frequently in media and tabloid contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
・{発覚|はっかく} - coming to light (passive discovery)
・{隠蔽|いんぺい} - concealment (opposite action)
・{告発|こくはつ} - accusation, disclosure (formal/legal)
